events.title: 'This Moment' — Contemporary Chinese Art Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition at HOTA Gallery showcases 35 artworks by 25 contemporary Chinese artists, exploring themes of identity, history, and transformation through large-scale installations, video, photography, painting, and sculpture. It provides a unique opportunity to engage with significant 21st-century Chinese art.

events.title: A Bigger View — National Gallery Masterworks Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition at HOTA brings together large-scale masterpieces from the National Gallery of Australia and HOTA's local collection, presented as part of the Sharing the National Collection initiative. It's an opportunity to see significant works on a grand scale.

events.title: HOTA Gallery Public Program — Talks & Workshops
events.datetime: Ongoing through this week (check HOTA site for specific sessions)
events.description: This recurring public program offers a variety of talks, guided tours, artist discussions, and hands-on workshops, designed to provide deeper engagement with the current exhibitions at HOTA Gallery. It caters to all ages and encourages exploration of artistic practice and ideas.

events.title: Flotsam Festival — Film & Photography Festival
events.description: The Gold Coast's annual Flotsam Festival is in its final week, showcasing film screenings and photography events across various venues. This celebration of visual arts offers a unique opportunity for film and photography enthusiasts to engage with diverse creative works.

events.title: Pride Art in the Park — HOTA Lake Picnic
events.datetime: This week (check HOTA/What's On for exact date)
events.description: A relaxed, free, community-oriented picnic by HOTA Lake with an arts and LGBTQIA+ focus, where everyone is welcome. This event fosters natural conversation and provides a welcoming space for social connection in a creative setting.

events.title: Gold Coast Jazz & Blues Club — Live Jazz
events.description: The Gold Coast Jazz and Blues Club presents a live jazz gig at HOTA, a recurring event known for attracting a thoughtful, musically engaged audience in an intimate setting. It's a key institution for live music on the Gold Coast.

events.title: Matiu Te Huki — Concert
events.description: New Zealand singer-songwriter Matiu Te Huki performs an intimate acoustic show in Bilambil, drawing a loyal and musically passionate audience. This is an opportunity to experience authentic folk-inspired music in a smaller venue.

events.title: Gold Coast Little Theatre: 'The Narcissist' (with Gold Coast Active & Social Group)
events.datetime: This week (check gclt.sales.ticketsearch.com for exact date)
events.location: Gold Coast Little Theatre (Surfers Paradise area)
events.description: 'The Narcissist' is a postmodern comedy of manners at Gold Coast Little Theatre, offering both riotous entertainment and social commentary. The Gold Coast Active & Social meetup group is attending, providing a social opportunity to see the play with new people.

events.title: HOTA Engages — IMPERFECT CREATIVES Workshop
events.description: This workshop at HOTA's Sunroom space, part of the HOTA Engages series, is aimed at curious creative minds aged 16 and over. Participants will explore making, artistic processes, and creative practice in a hands-on environment.

events.title: HOTA Engages — Hayden Andrews Ongoing Workshop Series
events.description: This ongoing hands-on creative workshop series at HOTA is led by Gold Coast artist Hayden Andrews, offering community participants the chance to engage in artistic practice. It's an opportunity to learn and create with a local artist.

events.title: Ballun Gawrehma: Story by the River — First Nations Cultural Storytelling
events.description: Part of HOTA's Talks & Ideas program, 'Ballun Gawrehma: Story by the River' offers First Nations cultural storytelling, connecting visitors with Kombumerri history and Country. This thought-provoking and place-centred program provides valuable cultural insights.

events.title: TableTopCon 2026 — Board Game Convention
events.location: Gold Coast Sports and Leisure Center, Carrara
events.description: TableTopCon 2026 is a community board game convention offering a mix of strategy, creativity, and social connection. It's an excellent opportunity to meet curious and playful people who enjoy deep conversations between rounds of games.

events.title: Robina Farmers Market
events.description: The weekly Robina Farmers Market offers fresh produce, artisan goods, gourmet food, and live music, creating an authentic local community atmosphere. It's a great spot for leisurely conversation and discovering small producers.

events.title: Sessions Surf Festival — Launch Week
events.datetime: Sat 23 May – Sat 30 May 2026 (first two days this week)
events.location: Various Gold Coast locations (incl. Mondrian Gold Coast, Miami Marketta, Burleigh Heads)
events.source: Inside Gold Coast / Gold Coast Magazine
events.description: The Sessions Surf Festival celebrates surf culture through film screenings, panel talks with athletes and creatives, live music, and art. The launch week includes events at Mondrian Gold Coast and live tunes at Miami Marketta, offering a blend of storytelling, inspiration, and laid-back socialising.

events.title: Sanctuary Cove International Boat Show — Cultural & Lifestyle Program
events.source: The Urban List / Inside Gold Coast
events.description: Beyond the marine exhibits, this prestigious event at Sanctuary Cove features a cultural and lifestyle program including wine tastings at a tasting deck, brunches, and a Sun Club. It appeals to those interested in the craft, design, and culture associated with marine lifestyle.
